source_message.text: On pricing, would you like information added directly, or should the bottom form include a line inviting people to contact us for pricing? The main design change is that I removed the top nav and footer links; because this is a fairly short landing page, links to specific sections aren't necessary.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports removing the landing page's top navigation.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Marissa,

After working on your landing-page design, I deployed it to S3 behind CloudFront at <https://cdn.lumenarc-demo.example>. I’ve also added more copy and made a few minor adjustments, and I think it’s coming together well. Please let me know what you think, and I hope you had a good weekend.

The tenant dashboard sign-in is now implemented and working, although it still needs LumenArc branding. The sign-up wizard is halfway through development, and I’ll add it only after it is fully functional. May I send you an invitation for a LumenArc login so you can review both? Let me know which email address I should use, or whether you would prefer that I create a <http://lumenarc-demo.example|lumenarc-demo.example> email account for you.

Regarding navigation, I agree with your decision to leave it out of the header. Instead, I’ll gradually add links to the footer, which appears to be the current trend; I captured several footer examples to see how others are handling it.

Best,
Derek

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Marissa,

I hope you had a fun trip to Croatia; it’s good to hear from you. The website and UI have both been taking shape well while I’ve been doing a lot of work on them. My immediate priority is fleshing out the website before it hopefully begins receiving substantial traffic.

Although it is not live yet, I’ve added a header menu along with related pages that are at different stages of completion. Two of these pages are solution descriptions for the platform and agents, as shown in the attached snapshots. Each page has space for a diagram, and I’ve already prepared rough drafts for those diagrams.

Could you help turn the drafts into production-ready versions that I can place on the site? If you cannot, perhaps you could recommend the best alternative approach.

The UI has also received further development and additional functionality, and I’m now calling it the Admin Workspace. I’ve settled on a look and feel and layout that I’m comfortable with, although the shades and tones still need a little polishing. I’ll send you a link so you can review it.

Regards,
Derek
